hook.name: RothWethFeeHook
hook.description: A single ROTH/WETH pool hook that collects a fixed 3% WETH fee on every swap via BeforeSwapDelta (when WETH is the specified token) and AfterSwapDelta (when it is not). Fees are accrued as PoolManager ERC-6909 credits and distributed in equal thirds to a terminal pot, a growth sink, and the creator address on each swap or via a public distribute() call.
